sections.heading: Strategy
sections.wikitext:
Storm Gladiotor is a good warrior minor hero, though you can better use [[TCG:OAL-057|Oddrey 2 - Biological Monster]], [[TCG:OAL-052|Bonelasher - Brutal Monster]] or [[TCG:LGS-049|Redcap - Chaotic Hunter]] as they do have the same attack and defense as Storm Gladiator and they do have a action and they won't exhaust when they come in play.

full_text:
== Strategy ==
Storm Gladiotor is a good warrior minor hero, though you can better use Oddrey 2 - Biological Monster, Bonelasher - Brutal Monster or Redcap - Chaotic Hunter as they do have the same attack and defense as Storm Gladiator and they do have a action and they won't exhaust when they come in play.
